issues.display_title: Issue #4347: fix(navigation): enable native middle-click new tab and link behavior across dashboard
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Middle-clicking (mouse wheel click / auxiliary click) on navigation items and links throughout app.gothru.co currently fails to open links in a new tab. Previously, a partial workaround was implemented in commit 125344b77 (PR #2270) that hardcoded onMouseDown (e.button === 1) exclusively for /my-tours across side menu files.

This issue aims to systematically resolve navigation link semantics across the entire dashboard so that middle-click, Ctrl+click, Cmd+click, and "Open link in new tab" work natively as expected.

Root Cause

  1. Missing href attributes on NextUI components: NextUI components such as ListboxItem, DropdownItem, and BreadcrumbItem only render semantic HTML <a> tags when provided an href prop. When omitted and driven solely by onPress={() => navigate(...)}, they render as <li>, <button>, or <span>, preventing browsers from recognizing them as links.
  2. Relative path and click interception in tour listings: In TourCard.jsx and ToursTable.jsx, href is defined without a leading slash (my-tours/...), causing invalid relative URL resolution on new tab opens. Furthermore, openTourDetail in List.jsx executes event.preventDefault() unconditionally.
  3. Non-semantic header links: The logo in Header.jsx uses href="javascript:;", opening broken/blank pages on middle-click.

Scope of Changes & Acceptance Criteria

  • Side Menus (MainMenu, AdvanceMenu, TourMenu, PhotographerNoviceMenu, PhotographerMenu, ProfileMenu, SupportMenu):
    • Add appropriate href props to all navigation ListboxItem components.
    • Remove hardcoded onMouseDown (e.button === 1 / window.open('/my-tours', '_blank')) workarounds.
  • Tour Listing (TourCard.jsx, ToursTable.jsx, List.jsx):
    • Fix relative href paths to absolute dynamic paths (/my-tours/${item.moderation_id} or /upload based on tour wizard/panoramas).
    • Ensure middle-click (e.button === 1) and modifier clicks (metaKey, ctrlKey) do not have their default browser behavior prevented.
    • Suppress href in selection mode so middle-click does not navigate while selecting tours.
  • Header & Breadcrumbs (Header.jsx, PageLayout.jsx):
    • Replace href="javascript:;" on the header logo with a valid route /.
    • Provide href props for BreadcrumbItem and DropdownItem navigation elements.
  • Verification:
    • Middle-click opens links in a new background tab natively.
    • Left-click maintains client-side SPA navigation via React Router without full page reloads and respects IsBlockingNavigate.
    • All existing unit tests pass.

Result

Screencast.From.2026-10-06.14-18-06.mp4
  • Implementation PR: #4348
  • Key Commits: 6e8748b0a
  • Testing Verification:
    • Unit test suite passed 100% (31/31 tests passed across getTourDetailPath.test.js, TourCard.test.jsx, ToursTable.test.jsx, List.test.jsx, App.test.jsx, Header.countly.test.jsx, portfolioWizard.test.js, MatchMenu.test.jsx).
    • Production build verification passed (npm run build completed successfully).

issues.display_title: Issue #4339: refactor(analytics): remove terminal payment outcome events in favor of server-side tracking
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Refactor Countly commercial analytics in the frontend to adhere to strict Separation of Concerns. The frontend should only track user browsing and intent funnels, while terminal financial states (payment_completed, payment_failed, subscription_changed, etc.) are moved exclusively to backend webhook handlers.

Scope & Objectives

  1. Remove Terminal Payment Events from PaymentV2.jsx:

    • Remove client-side triggers for:
      • payment_completed
      • payment_failed
      • subscription_changed
      • subscription_change_failed
      • payment_processing (SSE timeout diagnostic)
    • Remove obsolete trackPaymentOutcome and trackStripeLifecycle invocations in src/components/organism/PaymentV2/PaymentV2.jsx.

  2. Retain User Intent & UI Funnel Events:

    • Keep intact:
      • pricing_viewed (Subscription.jsx)
      • billing_cycle_changed (Subscription.jsx)
      • plan_selected (Subscription.jsx)
      • token_package_selected (TokenBuySection.jsx)
      • paywall_viewed (All 9 feature gate locations)
      • checkout_started (PaymentV2.jsx)
      • subscription_change_started (PaymentV2.jsx)
      • payment_cancelled (PaymentV2.jsx PayPal onCancel handler)

  3. Update Test Suites:

    • Update src/components/organism/PaymentV2/PaymentV2.countly.test.jsx to reflect the removal of terminal payment event assertions while ensuring intent events are thoroughly verified.
    • Verify npm test and npm run lint pass with 0 warnings/errors.

Result

  • Pull Request: #4340 (targeting base branch development)
  • Branch: refactor/countly-terminal-events-4339
  • Key Implementation Files:
    • Component: src/components/organism/PaymentV2/PaymentV2.jsx (eliminated all client-side triggers for payment_completed, payment_failed, subscription_changed, subscription_change_failed, and payment_processing)
    • Test Suite: src/components/organism/PaymentV2/PaymentV2.countly.test.jsx
  • Testing Evidence:
    • PaymentV2.countly.test.jsx: 53 tests passed, 100% pass rate.
    • ESLint: 0 errors on modified files.

issues.display_title: Issue #4341: feat(support): add Countly Analytics overview dashboard and navigation in Support section
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Add a new Countly Analytics dashboard view within the Support section (/support/analytics) to provide support and administrator staff with visibility into platform usage, visitor traffic, custom event activity, and payment outcome funnels.

Scope & Objectives

  1. Routing & Navigation:

    • Register new route /support/analytics under support routes (src/routes/support.js).

issues.display_title: Issue #4345: feat(analytics): implement post-P0 Countly custom events tracking across dashboard modules
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Implement post-P0 Countly custom events across core user workflows in GoThru Dashboard. This expands tracking coverage to 100% of functional user touchpoints while strictly adhering to privacy-safe (zero-PII) instrumentation standards.

Scope of Work

1. Whitelist & Enum Schema (src/utils/countly.js)

  • Expand ENUM_VALUES and SAFE_BOOLEAN_KEYS to include all new action keys, tools, sections, setting names, and discrete bucket categories (tool, filter_type, action, nadir_type, video_type, aspect_ratio, notification_category, schedule_type, target_type, etc.).
  • Update corresponding unit tests in src/utils/countly.test.js.

2. Account Security & Branding (src/pages/Auth/, src/pages/Profile/)

  • Password recovery & change flows: password_reset_requested, password_reset_completed, password_changed.
  • Company branding & account utilities: company_logo_uploaded, company_logo_deleted, account_setting_updated, user_metadata_copied.
  • Preferences & 3rd party keys: preference_changed, panorra_account_added, maps_key_added.

3. Tour Management, Batch Actions & Tagging (src/pages/Tour/List/, TourTools.jsx)

  • Tour lifecycle tools: tour_tool_started, tour_tool_queued, tour_tool_failed (clone, split, merge, transfer, archive, delete, change_type).
  • Batch operations: tour_batch_action_started, tour_batch_action_queued, tour_batch_action_failed.
  • Hashtag/tagging interactions: tour_tag_added, tour_tag_removed, tour_list_tag_filtered.
  • Search & navigation: tour_list_searched, tour_list_filtered, tour_opened.

4. Panorama & Creative Suite (Tour/Detail/Edit/, Nadir/, Blur/, Video/)

  • Panorama technical tools: panorama_gps_added, panorama_auto_leveled, panorama_panorra_published, google_panorama_deleted, panorama_downloaded.
  • External Tool Gateway launch: external_tool_launched (moderator_ai, overlay_editor).
  • Nadir & AI Blur: nadir_patch_*, global_nadir_*, ai_blur_*, manual_blur_opened.
  • Video generation: video_generation_*, video_downloaded, video_settings_saved.

5. Client CRM & Hosted Tours (src/pages/Crm/, Tour/Detail/Hosted/)

  • CRM interactions: crm_searched, crm_client_created, crm_client_updated, crm_client_deleted, crm_tour_assigned.
  • Hosted templates & multi-space: template_*, hotspot_exported, hotspot_imported, extra_virtual_tour_created, virtual_tour_scheduled, virtual_tour_cloned_to_account, virtual_tour_deactivated.

6. Notifications & Public Ecosystem

  • Notification center: notification_center_opened, notification_tour_clicked.
  • Portfolio & Directory: portfolio_*, photographer_*.

Acceptance Criteria

  • src/utils/countly.js schema updated and all new properties pass sanitization.
  • No PII (names, emails, IDs, coordinates, or raw errors) is transmitted to Countly.
  • Unit tests pass 100% with high coverage for modified components and utility functions.

Result

    • Total: 60/60 tests passing.

issues.display_title: Issue #4336: feat: Integrate Google Analytics 4 (GA4) for user traffic and engagement tracking
issues.main_description_html:
Description

We want to integrate Google Analytics 4 (GA4) into the GoThru Dashboard. This will help our team better understand user navigation, popular features, and overall traffic to support data-driven product improvements.

Proposed Solution

  • Integrate Google Analytics 4 via a lightweight React integration (react-ga4).
  • Track page views automatically whenever a user navigates between dashboard routes.
  • Use environment variables to configure the Measurement ID so tracking can be easily managed across different environments (development vs production).

Scope of Work

  • Add Google Analytics 4 configuration using environment variables.
  • Initialize GA4 on application launch.
  • Track page views on route changes across the dashboard.
  • Ensure analytics gracefully disables if no Measurement ID is provided (e.g. in local development).

Acceptance Criteria

  • Navigating between pages triggers a page view event in the Google Analytics Realtime report.
  • Analytics setup does not affect dashboard load time or degrade user experience.
  • The application functions normally if the tracking ID is not configured.

Demo by Developer

issues.display_title: Issue #4343: [Feature] Global Action Event Receiver & Page State Sync for RAG Copilot
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Enable the GoThru Dashboard host app to synchronize its active page state with the RAG widget and listen for native action events to trigger global modals (e.g., Create Hosted Tour) or route navigation.

Key Changes

  • Synchronize active route and page metadata into window.__GOTHRU_PAGE_STATE__ in src/components/layouts/Layout.jsx.
  • Add global listener for gothru:action events at the shell layout level.
  • Mount root-level modal handlers (<CreateHostedTour>, <CreateGoogleBusiness>) and route navigation handlers so actions can be executed from any page in the dashboard.
